svg.title: BioMate AI Platform Architecture
svg.desc: BioMate AI connects to 25+ integrations including MCP, Slack, WeChat Work, and 10 lab instruments. The AI orchestration layer routes requests to 4,000+ indexed workflows across 36 biomedical domains using hybrid vector search with 94.6% routing accuracy. Execution runs on AWS Batch via Nextflow and nf-core. Every output receives Gold/Silver/Bronze QC grading and includes an immutable audit trail. Outputs include structured reports, DOCX export, IND sections, CRO submission packages, and 21 CFR Part 11 e-signatures.
svg.text: AI assistant for biomedical research and application
